about.metaDescription: Get to know the story, mission and team of NGO DI MI PA BÔS, dedicated to transforming lives in Guinea-Bissau.
about.heroDescription: DI MI PA BÔS (also known as dimipabos) is an NGO in Guinea-Bissau, based in Bissau. We were born from the urgent need to offer adequate, humane treatment to people facing chemical dependency, and our mission is to build and operate the country's first specialised centre.
about.cardBody: We work tirelessly to build a space of shelter and recovery, where every person can find the support they need to start again.
historyParagraphs: NGO DI MI PA BÔS was founded in 2021 with a simple, essential purpose: to bring help to those who need it most. At first our focus was on donations, providing basic support to vulnerable people in Guinea-Bissau. Along the way, however, we recognised an even greater need — a safe, structured space to welcome and treat people struggling with chemical dependency.

From that realisation our flagship project was born: building a shelter and treatment centre for people facing challenges with substance use. The centre will be a place where they can recover with dignity, receiving appropriate treatment and continuous follow-up to ensure their rehabilitation and reintegration into society.

We are still in the construction phase, but every step we take is driven by our commitment to transforming lives. With the support of our community, partners and donors, we are building a future where more people get the chance to start over.
Join us on this mission and help make this dream a reality! 💙✨

centro-tratamento.title: Treatment and Rehabilitation Centre
centro-tratamento.description: The first specialised treatment and rehabilitation centre for people facing chemical dependency in Guinea-Bissau.
centro-tratamento.shortDescription: Specialised treatment with a multidisciplinary team.
centro-tratamento.longDescription:
Our flagship project is the construction of a modern, humane treatment centre. With the land already acquired in 2023, we are now in the fundraising phase to begin construction.

The centre will be equipped with:
• Dormitories for up to 20 people
• Communal and leisure areas
• Rooms for individual and group sessions
• Dining hall and industrial kitchen
• Space for therapeutic activities
